rationale: Keeps the current 9x512 reverse-tail baseline but changes the recurrent tail schedule shape inside the forward path: anchor carry now ramps in earlier via recur_gain*(2-recur_gain), while the extra shared block rewrite is delayed via recur_gain^2. This is a compact recurrence-scheduling transplant aimed at preserving the strong reverse-tail anchor behavior and improving late-run stability under the exact int8 roundtrip objective without adding parameters or export complexity.
title: Carry-First Reverse-Tail Recurrence
